description: This file defines data structures, constants, and methods related to Ginkgo test reporting, including test suite and spec reports, failure details, timeline events, and node types.

classes.name: ConstructionNodeReport
classes.description: Captures hierarchical information about a Ginkgo spec's construction containers.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Represents overall test suite execution data, including suite info, stats, and spec reports.

classes.name: PreRunStats
classes.description: Holds statistics about the test suite before execution.

classes.name: SpecReport
classes.description: Contains detailed information about an individual test spec, including hierarchy, status, failures, and timeline.

classes.name: TimelineLocation
classes.description: Marks the location of an event within a spec's timeline.

classes.name: Timeline
classes.description: A collection of timeline events, sortable and filterable.

classes.name: TimelineEvent
classes.description: Interface for events that occur during a spec's timeline.

classes.name: Failure
classes.description: Details about a test failure, including message, location, and context.

classes.name: FailureNodeContext
classes.description: Enum indicating the context of a failure node (leaf, top-level, container).

classes.name: AdditionalFailure
classes.description: Represents failures occurring after the initial failure, such as in cleanup.

classes.name: SpecState
classes.description: Enumeration of possible test spec states (passed, failed, skipped, etc.).

classes.name: ProgressReport
classes.description: Tracks progress and events during a spec's execution.

classes.name: Goroutine
classes.description: Represents a goroutine involved in a test's execution, including stack trace and state.

classes.name: FunctionCall
classes.description: Details of a function call within a goroutine, including source info.

classes.name: NodeType
classes.description: Enumeration of Ginkgo node types (container, It, BeforeEach, etc.).

classes.name: SpecEvent
classes.description: Captures various events during a spec's run, such as start, end, or retries.

classes.name: SpecEventType
classes.description: Enumeration of different types of spec events.
